uriChange: A4 provisional to A5 canonical only; frozen source identifiers and semantics unchanged

encoding.decode: percent-decode final suffix; do not lowercase or normalize source identifiers

versioning.specification: 0.1 embedded in stable canonical resource IRI
versioning.semanticChange: governed new version; do not mutate historical assertions
versioning.serializations: Turtle, N-Triples, JSON-LD share one canonical IRI per source identity
versioning.historical: historical aliases remain historical-term resources; never owl:sameAs

externalAuthorities: Scoped references to external authority identifiers, never assertions of ownership; no impersonation of issuer IRIs

iriGovernance.authorityBoundary: HDIP-CLA machine identity, not semantic/Product/Data/policy/Decision authority
iriGovernance.domainPublication: Requires site owner and deployment confirmation; unresolved IRIs do not invalidate logical graph identity
iriGovernance.iriRedirectPolicy: once publicly published do not repurpose identifiers; preserve redirects when possible
iriGovernance.noInference: No owl:sameAs, owl:equivalentClass, inverse/transitive characteristics or closed world defaults

a4GraphMetadata: A4 provisional metadata retained as literal historical source assertion, not active A5 policy
